_comment: Mutation testing for WhatSoup. Coverage% proves a line executed; mutation testing proves the (adversarial/unhappy) assertions would CATCH a regression. Scoped to the high-value memory/retrieval/consolidation modules (QR-003/005/011 hotspots) to keep runs tractable; widen `mutate` as coverage closes. Activate: npm install -D @stryker-mutator/core @stryker-mutator/vitest-runner
